blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) will use the messaging platform Viber to transmit election results during the Nov. 28 special elections in Batanes, aiming to speed up the canvassing process and allow the proclamation of the winner on election night. The special elections will determine the new representative of Batanes’ lone congressional district following the death of incumbent Rep. Ciriaco Gato Jr. last September. Comelec Chair George Erwin Garcia said on Thursday that municipal boards of canvassers would be allowed to send initial results to the provincial canvassing center through Viber while the official physical copies of election […]...
